# Proposed criteria for Mizusawa, Haruka and Rena

This is a preregistration proposal for root's internal freeze, after acquisition of the full root assessment/three admissions, all three complete literary inputs, relevant owner windows and current architecture §§16/17.2. It is not yet frozen or authority to construct. The producer must obtain root confirmation of the exact accepted preregistration identity before creating any of these three model arguments or behavior/scenario outputs. A later amendment must preserve the original and disclose already seen output. The sealed six-pilot folder remains unchanged.

Fifteen cases cover the distinctive ordinary ends, clocks, recipient/knowledge contrasts, actual local limits, contradictory self-theory and excluded fields of these three people. Nine R cases use known, already exposed literary evidence; six H cases are hypothetical requests with admissible constraint ranges and no canonical truth label. Neither is a blind prediction test. No numerical accuracy, ground-truth label for an invented scene, complete idiolect or acoustic claim may be made.

## Proposed execution and review contract

Each actual later record must identify: test ID/type; exact model hash/version; literal input; finite era and story clock; recipient and directional standing; actor-known versus reader-only/hypothetical information; stakes and actual alternatives; prior exposure; expected constraint range; actual output; field abstentions; producer-observed error; and independent review owner. An actual output may be a conditional behavioral range or third-person analytical trace. The recorder must not be described as an executable persona or independent oracle.

This first version proposes no freeform Japanese dialogue. It tests local communicative-act and register controls, with source-derived Japanese evidence as the anchor. New generated wording would require a disclosed amendment and its own actual fidelity review. Complete distinct speech is not disproved merely because no dependable full idiolect has been established or tested. No audio inspection exists.

Global errors include omitted era/standing, later/private knowledge leakage, false identity/actor, assent for the wrong object or time, hypothetical additions presented as canon, universal motive weights, caricature, empty all-abstention when useful admitted behavior is supported, and a model hypothesis fed back as literary evidence. Ordinary positive ends and real costs must both remain. If a selector is missing, clarify or return an explicitly conditional range. Keep all failed candidates/attempts and repair only through an attributable successor with affected retests. Producer observations never constitute the final PASS.
